summary: Completed testing of International Attendance Update Rate feature, duplicate PB-PERTH fix verification, and Payslip PDF generation. All backend tests passed (8/8). All frontend UI tests passed.

issues: Minor: Missing aria-describedby for DialogContent (accessibility warning in console)

update_hourly_rate_ui.details: Pencil icon next to rate column opens modal with employee name, category, current rate, and input for new rate. Save updates rate and refreshes table. Toast notification confirms update.

update_rate_backend_endpoint.details: POST /api/international-attendance/update-rate works with JSON body {token, center, employee_id, new_rate}. Validates negative rates (400), unauthorized center access (403).

weekly_data_loading.details: POST /api/international-attendance/week-data returns employees with employee_id, employee_name, hourly_rate, hours object, and summary. 5 employees loaded for PB-PERTH.

duplicate_perth_center_fix.details: Only 1 PB-PERTH center exists in database. GET /api/international-attendance/centers returns single PB-PERTH with country=Australia, currency=AUD, gst_rate=10%.

payslip_pdf_generation.details: POST /api/payslips_generate returns valid PDF for single employee mode. Bulk mode returns ZIP file containing multiple PDFs. PDF text overlap fix verified (box_bottom=2.2*inch).

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: DialogContent in Edit Rate modal missing aria-describedby attribute for accessibility compliance
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing PB-PERTH employees: PERTH-C001 (Sneha Patel), PERTH-C002 (Raj Sharma), PERTH-C003 (Priya Verma), PERTH-C004 (Amit Kumar), PERTH-C005 (Neha Singh).
context_for_next_testing_agent: International Attendance Update Rate feature is fully working. Edit rate modal opens via pencil icon, displays employee info and current rate, allows entering new rate, and saves successfully. Backend endpoint uses JSON body (not query params).
